title: Filter By with the Highlight Filter

div.h1: Filter by a product, keep the whole picture
div.p: Click a product on the left. The quarters on the right keep every region's full revenue, faded, with that product's share solid in front, so you see both how much it sold and how much of the business it is.
div.div: Click a product to filter the quarters by it.
